1523501.name: Luxurious Guns
1523501.description: Fires a barrage of rifle bullets, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1523502.name: Luxurious Cannons
1523502.description: Fires six lasers, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1523503.name: Luxurious Explosives
1523503.description: Fires eight missiles, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The missiles can be intercepted.

1523504.name: Luxurious Radiance
1523504.description: Fires a highly concentrated laser beam, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1523505.name: Investor Gathering
1523505.description:
Sensing danger, Luxurious Spider gathers surrounding Raptures in an attempt to regroup. It generates a code barrier while other Raptures are on the field. While the barrier is up, only Fire Code Nikkes can deal damage.
Additionally, Luxurious Spider becomes enraged, gaining increased ATK.

1523506.name: Luxurious Steps
1523506.description: Luxurious Spider lowers its front limbs, blocking a single Nikke's vision.

1523507.name: Luxurious Light
1523507.description: Fires a highly concentrated laser that pierces through cover. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals damage to all Nikkes.

1523509.name: Luxurious Mercenaries
1523509.description: Luxurious Spider buries its eggs in the ground and incubates them. The incubated Raptures will self-destruct, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1523510.name: Luxurious Body
1523510.description: Luxurious Spider jumps up and slams down, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
